history.submitter_remarks: Chinese-version-only notice; EN already known as Creasy Road on this G.N.

gazette_location.description_raw_en: No. 1151.—It is hereby notified that the Chinese Version of the name of the following road will in future be as described hereunder:— Description: Cul-de-sac, known as Creasy Road, commencing at its junction with Perkins Road and running in a south-westerly direction and then in a northerly direction and terminating at its junction with house No. 1 on I.L. 6391, as shown coloured red on plan R.H. 566A. Proposed Name: CREASY ROAD. Chinese Version: 祈禮士道.
